_howto: To add an episode: copy one block in 'episodes', set 'ep' (number), 'id' (the YouTube video ID, the part after watch?v= in the URL), and 'title'. 'story' is optional: write as much as you want and it appears under the player when that episode is opened. To start Season 2 someday, copy the whole season block. No HTML changes ever needed.
